entries.title: Plugin-based adapter loading at runtime not implemented
entries.expected: Runtime loading of adapters from shared libraries without recompilation
entries.observed: No plugin loader or dlopen-based dynamic loading exists in include/core/concerns/ or src/core/. Adapter selection is config-string-driven but requires compile-time linking. ROADMAP correctly marks as [I] (Issue: #1706).
evidence: include/core/concerns/: no plugin_loader.h or dlopen wrapper
entries.impact: All adapter implementations must be compiled in; runtime adapter replacement requires restart
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(core): plugin-based adapter loading at runtime (Issue: #1706)

entries.title: Dynamic log level adjustment at runtime not implemented
entries.expected: ILogger::setLevel() or equivalent for runtime log level changes
entries.observed: ILogger has no setLevel() method. SpdlogLoggerAdapter does not expose dynamic level setting. ROADMAP correctly marks as [I] (Issue: #1412).
entries.impact: Log level changes require process restart
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(core): dynamic log level adjustment at runtime (Issue: #1412)

entries.title: Audit event interface for compliance logging not implemented
entries.expected: IAuditEvent interface for compliance-relevant event logging
entries.observed: No i_audit.h or IAuditEvent interface found in include/core/concerns/. ROADMAP correctly marks as [I] (Issue: #1418).
entries.impact: Compliance audit trail must be implemented at application layer
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(core): audit event interface for compliance logging (Issue: #1418)
